main_text.head: Quomodo probas, omne quod moveatur, ab alio moveri?
main_text.l: Eorū quæ movent vel moventur, quædam movent vel moventur
1. Secundum se: et horum quidem alia
2. Secundum partem: ut quando homo dicitur percuti, quia manus percutitur.
3. Secundum accidēs: sicut homo movetur, quia est in naui quæ movetur: itē musicus sanat, quia is qui sanat, musices est peritus.
Rursus, eorum quæ per se mo{*}uentur, quædā mouentur
Natura: ut animata, item gravia & levia.
Vi, sive praeter naturam: ut aliquando animata & eorundem partes, tum terra sursum mota.

page.notes: The left label's reference mark "{*}" stands at the brace, between "mo" and "uentur". The word "mouentur" is printed with u for consonant v and is given as "moventur" in the same way as the other u/v forms. The label is a synopsis, so its boxes are written as outline lines.
